message: A skill is a folder of instructions the model reads before it starts
yt_title: The best AI skill doesn't answer you. It asks first.
yt_desc:
The smartest AI users quietly switched to skills, and most people still haven't.

A skill isn't a prompt. It's a folder of instructions the model reads before it starts working.

The best one doesn't answer you at all at first — it asks. Which market. What constraints. How many hours a week you actually have. Then it builds against your answers instead of its assumptions.

Another is Unslop, which exists for exactly one job: removing the writing that sounds like a template.

All five, free, on the channel.

lines.text: The smartest AI users quietly switched to something called skills, and most people still have not.
A skill is not a prompt. It is a folder of instructions the model reads before it starts working.
And the best one does not answer you at all at first. It asks you questions.
Which market you are in. What your real constraints are. How many hours a week you actually have.
Then it builds against your answers instead of against its own assumptions. That is the whole trick.
Another one is called Unslop, and it exists for exactly one job. Removing writing that sounds like a template.
